full_name: Pamela Lins | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Arts David and Roberta Logie Fellow Cooper Union, Princeton University
bio: Pamela Lins refers to her work primarily as sculpture, although she uses the term expansively. She teaches sculpture at the Cooper Union for the Advancement of Science and Art and painting at Princeton University.
